falseSynonyms.zh: monitor 強調持續觀察狀態或變化；keep track of 更廣，也可只是記住、跟進或記錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The system monitors temperature continuously. I keep track of all my appointments.

falseSynonyms.zh: follow 偏持續關注發展；keep track of 也可強調數量、位置或記錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She follows the court case closely. The app keeps track of each payment.

falseSynonyms.word: keep track of / stay informed about
falseSynonyms.zh: stay informed about 只強調掌握資訊；不一定親自監控或記錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I stay informed about policy changes. I keep track of every change in the spreadsheet.

falseSynonyms.zh: watch 強調觀察；keep track of 常包含記憶、記錄或進度管理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We watched the storm approach. We kept track of the storm's position on the map.

falseSynonyms.zh: record 是把資訊保存下來；keep track of 不一定留下正式紀錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The device records heart rate data. I keep track of how I feel each day.

falseSynonyms.word: keep track of / keep up with
falseSynonyms.zh: keep up with 是不落後於快速變化；keep track of 是持續知道／記錄其狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is hard to keep up with the news. I keep track of the stories I want to read.

falseSynonyms.zh: count 只求出數量；keep count of 才有持續計數、避免失去數量資訊的意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She counted the tickets once. She kept count of the tickets as people entered.

falseSynonyms.zh: track 可作動詞；tracking 可作動名詞／現在分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We track monthly costs. Tracking monthly costs helps control the budget.
